title: What to Prep Before the Doors Open

scenes.say: What should be ready before you unlock the door?
Work backwards from opening. Clean first, then stock the stations, then the first drink, then unlock.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: If I'm hunting for lids at eight in the morning, I've already lost the rush.

props.name: Dev
props.quote: Hunting for lids at 8 means I've *lost* the rush.

scenes.say: So: write one opening list. Stock to a set level every night. And taste the first drink before guests do.
